name: inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-f1-subword-16w
notes: sixteen words is the declared maximum, so the eleven-word mixed LB/LH/LW/LBU/LHU/SB/SH/SW program of the patch plan fits

the subword opt-in of scripts/inprocess_obi_apb_f1f6_spike.cpp: F1_ALLOW_SUBWORD=1 from f1_subword, so the host's make_record gate admits LB/LH/LW/LBU/LHU/SB/SH/SW and the RAM routes accept the CPU's byte enables

no DMA model is declared, so F6 is refused by name (unsupported-f6:no-dma-model:APB); the timer declares its four F5 facts and the Ibex CPU declares a one-bit machine-external IRQ input, so F5 stays available but is not used by an F1-only batch
the RAM image and the APB target window repeat the values of configs/scenarios/inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-zipdma-f1f6-program.json; only the F1 trampoline capacity and the subword opt-in differ
